text:
On its own, an AI chatbot doesn't look things up. It predicts the next word. Here's why that matters 🤖

Unless they use a search tool, large language models generate text by predicting likely next tokens from patterns learned in training. That makes them fluent, but they can produce confident errors called hallucinations. Give context and the format you want, and for facts ask for sources you can check.

Follow for the next one: three prompts that get better answers.
